findings: V3 requires one fully supported option and explicit contradiction of all others. Relative evidence discrimination is stricter than needed under this rule.
V3 question-content coverage supported only 3/300; generic whole-question requirements duplicate option support and can require unobservable purpose declarations.

Example 68f6ddfd gold option preparing a meal is called unresolved because captions do not explicitly state preparing a meal. This is direct evidence of rejecting activity inference, not proof that every unresolved label is wrong.
Other cases genuinely lack specific actions, identities or relations in captions; weaker thresholds alone would conceal these gaps.
Only 13 cases receive relevance reconsideration and only 8 change: V3 rescue discards references attached to partial/unresolved option evidence.

192 final source lists have at least one temporal order reversal because new scene captions are appended. V4 leaves rendering/order unchanged to isolate retrieval/readiness changes; timestamps remain explicit.

Existing V3 synthetic end-to-end gate checked retrieval and final answers but did not require successful readiness after repair. V4 requires actual early stop, negative gap probes and explicit opponent checks.
V3 option audit is 68.724% of new processing. V4 reduces repeated full-option declarations, keeps exact-input reuse, and retains total budgets; measured cost still requires evaluation.
scope_note: All 300 stage/cost traces analyzed; semantic examples inspected include all six Qplus regressions versus fixed-source V3 and six of twenty improvements. No new benchmark labels enter prompts.

planned_v4_design.filter_and_reader: Unchanged V3 question-only contribution filter and literal Q/Qplus rendering; only keep reaches final readers
planned_v4_design.proposal: Untrusted option nomination with exact letter-to-text binding and source references; never passed to reader
planned_v4_design.comparison: Each proposed candidate checked against every other option using exact option_A/option_B text and A/B/U decisions; positive discrimination instead of proving every rival false
planned_v4_design.constraints: All comparisons must favor candidate with real allowed references, no explicit gap, required temporal regions covered; missing comparison, stronger rival, missing time or solely qualified support blocks readiness
planned_v4_design.qualified_guard: Conservative lexical guard for may/might/could/perhaps/possibly/maybe/apparently/seem/appear/if in cited observations; a qualified option may retain its qualification. Not a complete semantic parser; mixed clauses may over-block.
planned_v4_design.rescue: Source pool/keep pool comparison, with relevant partial witnesses now eligible for reassessment; nominations never force keep
planned_v4_design.retrieval: Same archive and <=4 added scenes; no new pixel inference; same original budgets and cost accounting
planned_v4_design.control: Separate same-cohort fixed-depth control uses identical prompts and budgets but disables readiness early stop
planned_v4_design.measurement: Accuracy, regression/fix pairs, early stop frequency, scenes, tokens and new/source/setup/validation/failure costs; no claims before evaluation
